title: Prototype Pattern
description: Clone existing objects without depending on their classes.

data.text:
**Prototype Pattern**

Creates new objects by cloning an existing prototype instance, avoiding expensive object creation.
In C#, implement ICloneable or use copy constructors. Deep copy vs shallow copy is important.

data.title: Prototype Pattern
Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Use prototype when object creation is expensive or complex.
